definitions.meaning: A sounding together, concordance of voices or sounds, united voice

quotations.english: they bless the most excellent Lord thus with united voice

source_text: efen-hleóðor, -hleóðres; m. A sounding together, concordance of voices or sounds, united voice; concentus :-- Bletsiaþ Bregu sélestan efenhleóðre ðus they bless the most excellent Lord thus with united voice, Exon. 64 b; Th. 239, 15; Ph. 621.
